title: 🛒 Beginner’s Guide: How to Buy Products from China with Our Website？
content:
If this is your first time using our website, this guide will help you understand the full process — from choosing products, placing an order, paying for the items, waiting for warehouse arrival, submitting international shipping, and finally receiving your parcel.

With our service, you can buy products from Chinese platforms such as 1688, Taobao, Weidian, and other online marketplaces, even if you do not have a Chinese payment account or shipping address.


🌟 How the whole process works

Buying from China through our website usually includes these steps:

  1. Create an account
  2. Search for products or paste a product link
  3. Choose product options, such as color, size, and quantity
  4. Submit your shopping order
  5. Pay for the product cost
  6. We purchase the item from the Chinese seller
  7. The seller ships the item to our China warehouse
  8. The item arrives at the warehouse
  9. You check the item information and warehouse photos
  10. You submit the items for international shipping
  11. You choose a shipping method
  12. You pay the international shipping fee
  13. We pack and ship your parcel
  14. You track the parcel and wait for delivery


1. 👤 Create your account

Before placing an order, please create an account on our website.

After logging in, you can manage:

  • Your shopping orders
  • Warehouse items
  • International parcels
  • Shipping addresses
  • Account balance
  • Payment records
  • Refunds and after-sales requests

We recommend adding your shipping address before submitting your first parcel. This helps avoid address mistakes when your items are ready to ship.


2. 🔍 Find the product you want to buy

You can find products in several ways:

  • Paste a product link from 1688, Taobao, Weidian, or other supported platforms
  • Search by keyword on our website
  • Search by product image, if this feature is available
  • Contact customer service and send the product link or image for help

When choosing a product, please check the details carefully, including:

  • Product name
  • Product photos
  • Price
  • Color
  • Size
  • Style
  • Quantity
  • Seller information
  • Shipping fee within China

If the product has different options, please make sure you select the correct color, size, model, or specification before submitting the order.


3. 📝 Submit your shopping order

After selecting the product, please submit your shopping order.

Before submitting, please confirm:

  • The product link is correct
  • The selected options are correct
  • The quantity is correct
  • Any special notes are clearly written
  • The estimated product cost is acceptable

If you have special requirements, such as “please choose size M” or “please confirm the color with the seller before purchasing,” you can leave a note in the order.


4. 💳 Pay for the product cost

After submitting the order, the system will calculate the first payment.

This payment usually includes:

  • Product price
  • Domestic shipping fee in China
  • Service fee, if applicable
  • Other purchasing-related fees, if applicable

Once your payment is completed, we will start purchasing the item from the Chinese seller.

Please note: this first payment usually does not include the international shipping fee. International shipping is calculated later, after the item arrives at our China warehouse.


5. 🛍️ We purchase the item for you

After your payment is confirmed, we will purchase the item from the Chinese seller.

During this stage, the following situations may happen:

  • The product is purchased successfully
  • The product is out of stock
  • The seller changes the price
  • The selected option is unavailable
  • The seller does not ship the item
  • The order needs your confirmation

If there is any issue, we will notify you through the order page or customer service.


6. 🚚 The seller ships the item to our China warehouse

After the item is purchased, the Chinese seller will ship it to our China warehouse.

This is domestic shipping inside China. The delivery time depends on the seller’s location, the courier company, and the product availability.

You can check the order status on your account page.

Common statuses during this stage may include:

  • Purchased
  • Seller Shipped
  • Waiting for Warehouse Arrival
  • Pending Warehousing


7. 📦 The item arrives at our warehouse

When the item arrives at our China warehouse, our warehouse team will process it.

Warehouse processing may include:

  • Scanning the package
  • Matching it with your order
  • Checking the quantity
  • Taking warehouse photos
  • Weighing the item
  • Updating the item status

After the item is successfully stored, you can view it in your warehouse account.


8. 🖼️ Check warehouse photos and item information

Once your item is stored in the warehouse, you may be able to view warehouse photos or basic inspection photos.

These photos help you check:

  • Whether the item has arrived
  • Whether the color or style looks correct
  • Whether the quantity is correct
  • Whether there is any obvious damage
  • Whether the package condition looks normal

Please note that warehouse photos are only a basic visual check. They are not professional product authentication, quality inspection, or size verification unless you request a special service.


9. 📦 Submit items for international shipping

After your items arrive at the warehouse, you can choose which items you want to ship internationally.

You can:

  • Ship one item alone
  • Combine multiple items into one parcel
  • Wait for more items to arrive before shipping
  • Request extra services, such as repacking or reinforcement

Combining several items into one parcel may help reduce shipping costs in some cases.

Before submitting international shipping, please make sure:

  • The items are correct
  • You do not need to return or exchange them
  • Your shipping address is accurate
  • The items are allowed to be shipped to your country


10. ✈️ Choose an international shipping method

When submitting your parcel, you need to choose an international shipping method.

Different shipping methods may have different:

  • Prices
  • Delivery times
  • Weight limits
  • Size limits
  • Tracking services
  • Customs requirements
  • Restricted item rules
  • Compensation rules

Please choose a shipping method based on your country, product type, budget, and delivery time requirement.

If you are not sure which method to choose, you can contact customer service for advice.


11. 💰 Pay the international shipping fee

After you submit your parcel, the system will calculate the international shipping fee based on:

  • Destination country or region
  • Actual weight
  • Package size
  • Shipping method
  • Product type
  • Extra services
  • Customs or tax-related rules, if applicable

After you pay the international shipping fee, our warehouse will arrange packing and dispatch.


12. 🌍 Track your parcel

After your parcel is shipped, you can check the tracking number and delivery status in your account.

International tracking may not update immediately. Sometimes, tracking information only updates after the parcel reaches a transit center, airport, customs office, or destination country.

Please wait patiently and check the tracking page regularly.


Important notes

  • The first payment is usually for product purchasing only.
  • International shipping is usually paid separately after the item arrives at our warehouse.
  • Please choose product options carefully before submitting your order.
  • Some products may be restricted or prohibited for international shipping.
  • Customs duties or import taxes may be charged by your destination country.
  • International delivery time may be affected by customs, weather, flights, holidays, or local courier delays.
  • If you are unsure about any product, shipping method, or fee, please contact customer service before placing the order.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Will the item be shipped directly to my home after I pay for the product?

No. The item will first be shipped from the Chinese seller to our China warehouse. After it arrives at our warehouse, you need to submit it for international shipping and pay the international shipping fee.

Q2: Why do I need to pay twice?

The first payment is for purchasing the product from the Chinese seller. The second payment is for international shipping from our China warehouse to your country.

Q3: Can I combine several items into one parcel?

Yes. After your items arrive at the warehouse, you can select multiple items and submit them together for international shipping.

Q4: Can I return or exchange an item after it arrives at the warehouse?

It depends on the seller’s return policy and the item condition. If you need to return or exchange an item, please contact customer service as soon as possible. Once the item is shipped internationally, returns are usually much more difficult.

Q5: What should I do if I do not know which shipping method to choose?

You can contact customer service and provide your destination country, item type, estimated weight, and delivery time requirement. We will give you a suitable suggestion based on the available shipping methods.


Need help?

If you have any questions during the process, please contact our customer service team.

To help us assist you faster, please provide:

  • Your order number
  • Product link or screenshot
  • Parcel number, if available
  • Your destination country
  • A clear description of the problem

We will help you check the order, warehouse status, shipping method, or payment issue as soon as possible.
